Comment: CHHAYA Phase 5 — re-precompute orchestration (§10 Phase 5, offline-MVP scope). States: FetchData -> RunShadeSeason (Map over seasons -> PrecomputeHandler stub per §6.2) -> ValidateGraph (§7.6 minimums via the same stub) -> UploadArtifacts (pass-through to the pipeline/upload.py contract) -> WriteManifest (manifest stub — the Lambda-stub choice over the direct S3 integration is recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md). RunShadeSeason's Catch routes any to a Fail state whose ExecutionsFailed metric is the §7.9 notify signal on the CloudWatch dashboard.

FetchData.Comment: Pass-through of the run_pipeline.sh-composed ingest contract {GRAPH_BUCKET, S3_KEY_GRAPH, seasons} — the SAME bucket/key env-name contract the route Lambda reads (task brief), so a future real compute can swap in unchanged.

RunShadeSeason.Comment: Map over the season terms (§6.2: summer, monsoon) — each item invokes the PrecomputeHandler stub with the {season, GRAPH_BUCKET, S3_KEY_GRAPH} contract.

InvokePrecompute.Comment: PrecomputeHandler stub: head_object the routing bundle, assert §7.6 minimums, write s3://<GRAPH_BUCKET>/manifest/<season>.json, return {status, season, manifest_key}.

ValidateGraph.Comment: Small validator (the same PrecomputeHandler stub) on the FIRST season result: head_object + §7.6 minimums. Results arrive in the SAME order as the seasons list (Step Functions consolidates results in iteration order), so index 0 is summer. Failure notifies via the shared Fail state; the state machine re-run owned error retry is capped at 2 attempts (§5.3 retry budget).

UploadArtifacts.Comment: Pass-through to the upload contract used by pipeline/upload.py — this state EXISTS as the §7.9 upload slot; on the offline MVP the upload runs locally (pipeline/upload.py) before the state machine is invoked, so the stub validates the already-uploaded bundle.

WriteManifest.Comment: Chosen contract: manifest.json is written by the PrecomputeHandler Lambda stub, NOT the direct S3:PublishToAwsManagedStates integration (§7.9) — justified in docs/DECISIONS.md as stub-testability without Docker and the explicit write path. The manifest object is idempotent (same season -> same key).

NotifyValidationFailure.Comment: §7.9 fail->notify slot: the failed execution is the notification (ExecutionsFailed metric on the chhaya-mvp dashboard — docs/DECISIONS.md).
NotifyValidationFailure.Cause: Precompute validation or manifest write failed — see the execution's step history for the state that failed.
